infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow KhanaLagao to use the camera so you can scan table QR codes and capture menu / expense photos.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow KhanaLagao to use the microphone so you can dictate orders with voice.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow KhanaLagao to access your photos so you can attach menu images and expense receipts.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Allow KhanaLagao to save receipts and reports to your Photos library.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Allow KhanaLagao to access your location so delivery riders can share live ETAs and outlet check-ins work correctly.
